prompt: Aster has been set aside for another job. The designer can remove up to one metre from the revised lobby layout, but neither margin nor the backing or single-roll rule can change. What would make the lobby work possible?
promptZh: Aster 已留給另一個工作。設計師最多可以從新版大廳版面減一公尺，但兩側餘量、背膠和單卷規定都不能改。哪個做法能讓大廳工作照常進行？

options.text: Use Birch after trimming one metre from the layout.
options.zh: 把版面縮短一公尺，改用 Birch。
options.whyZh: Birch 的寬與長不成問題，但大廳不能用永久背膠。

options.text: Use Cedar without shortening the layout.
options.whyZh: Cedar 長度充足且可移除，但寬只等於展板本身，未含餘量。

options.text: Shorten the revised layout by one metre and use Dune.
options.zh: 把新版版面縮短一公尺，使用 Dune。
options.whyZh: 十二公尺減一為十一；Dune 可用十一、寬六十且背膠可移除。

options.text: Keep the revised length and join Dune to part of Cedar.
options.zh: 維持新版長度，把 Dune 接上一段 Cedar。
options.whyZh: 即便加長，拼接仍違反單卷規定。

explanationZh: 十二公尺減一為十一；Dune 可用十一、寬六十且背膠可移除。
evidence: Use film with removable backing; permanent backing is approved only for the rear workshop sign, not the lobby. / The lobby panel is 58 cm wide. Its two edges require one extra centimetre of film on each side, so the roll width must allow for both margins. / The original layout required 10 metres. The designer has added two metres of printed material to the same layout. / Prepare the full length from a single roll: a join would cross the middle of a word. / Aster | 62 | 14 | removable / Birch | 64 | 12 | permanent / Cedar | 58 | 16 | removable / Dune | 60 | 11 | removable

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Use film with removable backing; permanent backing is approved only for the rear workshop sign, not the lobby.
The lobby panel is 58 cm wide. Its two edges require one extra centimetre of film on each side, so the roll width must allow for both margins.
The original layout required 10 metres. The designer has added two metres of printed material to the same layout.
Prepare the full length from a single roll: a join would cross the middle of a word.

vocabulary.note: 計算寬度時須加上兩側所需的餘量。
